name: mcservermanager
description: Local Minecraft Server Manager (Aternos-inspired) with visual YAML/JSON/TOML config studio, plugin/mod manifest support, and Windows system tray console

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build:linux: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:tray
